value.rationale: A canonical geometrically self-similar mask yields a full noncompact interior essential concentration band with simultaneous uniform sampling on the observed and unobserved sets. Spectral counting has a continuum-valued cutoff phase transition while logarithmic weighting restores a unique distribution. The explicit first-order collapse coefficient and high-weight maximal broadening quantify the spectral behavior across all admissible Bergman weights; this is not a mere recomputation of isolated coefficients.
